question: By what name did Vinayak Savarkar form a secret organization of revolutionaries in the year 1904?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Bharat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vinayak Savarkar** formed a secret organization of revolutionaries called **Abhinav Bharat** in the year **1904.**
 
• First established as **"Mitra Mela"** in **Nasik**, it was Vinayak Savarkar's final year at **Fergusson College in Pune.**
 
• Following a few assassinations of British officials, the Savarkar brothers were found** guilty and sentenced to prison.**
 
• In **1952, **the society was formally dissolved.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustan Republic Association** was formed by **Sachindra Nath Sanyal.**

 
 
• It was founded in **1924.**
 
 
 
• **Naujawan Bharat Sabha **was founded in the year 1926, Bhagat Singh founded the Naujawan Bharat Sabha whose aim was to encourage revolution against British Rule by rallying the peasants and the workers.
 
• **Forward Bloc** was a political party formed by **Subhas Chandra Bose.**
 
 
• It was founded in **1939.**
